persona: You are a prompt optimization expert.
task_intent: The L1 inner optimization loop has stalled — candidates are no longer improving.
instruction:
Analyze the failure patterns from the critique and recommend changes. You can adjust:
- optimizer_params (creativity, n_variants, sp_budget_ttest, variant_strategy)
- task_context (refine domain, pipeline_purpose, data_characteristics, optimization_goals, key_challenges)
Your "directive" field will be injected into the next candidate generation prompt as primary guidance — make it specific and actionable.
Focus on what will have the biggest impact on accuracy.
answer_format:
Return a JSON object with:
  "optimizer_params": dict of meta-setting changes (creativity, n_variants, sp_budget_ttest — or {} to keep current)
  "task_context": dict of refined domain fields (or {} to keep current)
  "action": "continue" (normal L1 cycle) or "probe" (test warned queries with new settings first)
  "directive": 2-3 sentence strategic guidance for the next candidate generator — what problem to solve and why, not specific parameter values (L1 decides those)
  "rationale": 1-2 sentence explanation

Note: L1 Generate makes the final decision on pipeline_params. Your job is to refine the situation context and meta-settings so L1 makes better choices.
Use your judgment on when to set action to "probe" vs "continue" based on the data above.
